mapper.select: select * from tb_category order by category_no

select * from tb_category
and upper(category_name) like '%' || upper(#{keyword}) || '%'
and use_yn = #{useYn}
order by category_no
select * from tb_category where use_yn = 'Y' order by category_name
select count(*) from tb_category where category_name = #{categoryName}
mapper.insert: insert into tb_category (category_no, category_name, use_yn) values (seq_category.nextval, #{categoryName}, #{useYn})
